text:
As someone with a lot of dental experience, I can give a very strong positive recommendation about Dr. Obi, at S-Dental.
I went to see him for a “2nd opinion”, about a possible cavity that a dentist in Chiang Mai claimed required extensive dental work.
Since I had had no problems or symptoms with that tooth, I went to Dr. Obi to get re-evaluated.

Dr. Obi took x-rays of the tooth, and carefully examine them.
Next, he thoughtfully took the time to explain to me how he saw no evidence of decay or other problems, and no need at the present time to work on the tooth.
Finally, he went above and beyond, by showing me images of what an x-ray might show, if there were a concerning cavity or other dental lesion.

I was the last patient of the day, and, as it was Saturday night, I would expected the dentist and his staff to try and end the visit as quickly as possible. But Dr. Obi took the time to answer all my questions, explain and demonstrate why he did not see a problem to be addressed at that time, and gave me a good follow up plan. Thank you for a job well done, Dr. Obi, and the staff at S-Dental!
